before.title: Philly Scrapple Sticker, Hand Drawn Philadelphia Breakfast Decal, Retro Food Gift, Waterproof Vinyl
before.description:
Scrapple: Philly's most misunderstood breakfast, hand-lettered with a "Since 1776" crest and a hand-drawn leafy border.
 
Choose your finish:
• Regular: glossy laminated, waterproof vinyl
• Holographic: sparkly, light-catching finish (sparkle looks different in every light)
 
• Die cut with rounded corners
• Size: 1.95" x 1.95"
 
Drawn, designed, printed, and cut by me, who I am told is a human. No AI was used in the creation of these stickers.
 
Photo notes: photos 1, 2, 3 and 7 show the real sticker. Photos 4, 5 and 6 are digital mockups that show the sticker at its actual size. Photo 8 shows my drawing process. Photo numbers refer to the image order in this listing.
 
Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any brand, professional sports team, or league.
